article.title: Integrated multi-omics identifies distinct immune signatures with diagnostic and therapeutic implications in immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced myocarditis.
article.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis (ICI-myocarditis) is a rare but frequently fatal immune-related adverse event. A comprehensive understanding of the cellular and molecular determinants driving ICI-myocarditis is essential for improving diagnostic precision and developing targeted interventions. We delineate the immune landscape of ICI-myocarditis via scRNA-seq, flow cytometry, Olink proteomics, and multiplex cytokine profiling. We demonstrate that high levels of baseline ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells are linked to the proinflammatory features of monocytes and in vitro experiments confirm the existence of circulating ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells with a high potential to induce cardiomyocyte apoptosis, supporting their pathogenic potential for cardiomyocyte cytotoxicity. Notably, intercellular crosstalk between these subsets is possibly mediated via the CCL2-CCR2 axis, and its blockade attenuated ICI-induced cardiac injury in vivo. Based on the inflammatory signature in ICI-myocarditis, we develop an 8-protein custom panel with promising performance in distinguishing ICI-myocarditis from other ICIs-treated controls. JAK-STAT pathway activation promotes inflammatory programs in both ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T cells and monocytes. Furthermore, JAK-STAT inhibition ameliorates cardiac dysfunction and inflammatory infiltration while enhancing the response to anti-PD-1 therapy in mouse models. In summary, this study implicates immune-pathogenic features of ICI-myocarditis and provides a possible basis for future therapies.

score.summary_kr: 본 연구는 면역관문억제제 유발 심근염(ICI-myocarditis)의 면역학적 메커니즘을 규명하기 위해 scRNA-seq, 유동세포분석, Olink 단백질체학, 다중 사이토카인 프로파일링을 통합한 다중오믹스 접근을 수행했습니다. ISG15⁺CD8⁺ T세포와 단핵구 간의 CCL2-CCR2 축 상호작용이 심근세포 손상을 매개하며, JAK-STAT 경로 억제가 심기능 개선과 항-PD-1 치료 반응 증진을 유도함을 보였습니다. 8개 단백질 바이오마커 패널을 개발하여 ICI-심근염의 진단적 성능을 보여주었습니다.
key_points: Multi-omics (scRNA-seq, 단백질체학, 사이토카인 프로파일링) 통합으로 약물유해반응(ADR) 메커니즘 규명
바이오마커 패널 개발을 통한 정밀진단 및 치료타겟(JAK-STAT, CCL2-CCR2) 제시
심혈관질환의 면역학적 특성 분석으로 만성질환 정밀의료 적용 가능성
score.reason: 다중오믹스와 약물유해반응 예측·진단이 핵심 키워드로 일치하나, 만성대사질환(당뇨/신장질환/뇌졸중)이 아닌 암치료 관련 심독성이라는 특수한 질환군 대상으로 직접 관련성은 중간 수준입니다.
